name: Moody Farms and Flowers
tagline: Spring Bucket List: Walk Through Tulip Fields and Meet Farm Animals at Moody Blooms in East Texas
description: Moody Farms and Flowers is a working berry farm in Mount Pleasant, TX. It grows Blackberries, Pears, Peaches, Persimmons, and Limes, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
